description: 视频封面专用 Q 版 IP 形象档案。生成任何新表情前必须读取本档案，逐项对齐 appearance，避免形象漂移。

appearance.character: young East Asian man, Apple Memoji adult proportions, youthful rounded face, not a child, not big-eyed chibi
appearance.hat: light slate-gray / periwinkle knit beanie (#A7B3C6) with two small rounded bear ears on top, same color as the hat
appearance.glasses: thin black oval eyeglasses, not perfectly round cartoon circles
appearance.hair: short dark hair neatly peeking at both sides of the beanie
appearance.clothing: matching light slate-blue crewneck sweater over a thin black shirt collar

render_style: Soft glossy 3D render, Apple Memoji aesthetic, clean smooth shading, vivid and charming
background_requirement: pure solid green screen chroma key, no shadow on background, sharp clean edges for cutout
framing: upper body bust shot, facing slightly toward viewer
anchor_rule: 迭代形象时至少保留两个 identity_anchors，让老观众仍能认出

惊叹.prompt_fragment: amazed and impressed, eyes slightly widened but still Memoji-adult, mouth open in a small surprised wow, one hand raised to his cheek
惊叹.use_case: 展示厉害的东西、技术炫技类封面

思考.prompt_fragment: one hand on cheek, slightly tilted head, curious thoughtful expression, small slightly open mouth, looking slightly to the right

无语.prompt_fragment: half-lidded flat eyes, straight line mouth, one eyebrow raised in resignation

兴奋.prompt_fragment: big open smile, both fists raised in excitement, sparkling eyes

指向.prompt_fragment: pointing index finger toward the viewer's right side, confident smile
指向.use_case: 引导观众看画面里的界面元素

疑惑.prompt_fragment: head tilted, one eyebrow up, both palms turned up in a questioning gesture
疑惑.use_case: 疑问式标题、对比评测类
